name: Polymer probe recordings from hippocampus (LFP), OFC, NAc, and mPFC
description: Fixed the NWB file of a recording made with 64-channel polymer probes in the hippocampus, orbitofrontal cortex, nucleus accumbens and medial prefrontal cortex of a rat resting in a box.
Inspected it with the NWB Inspector, and reported the bugs it turned up in the inspector itself.
Resulted in **0.24 TB** of rat electrophysiology and behavioral data on the NIH data archive, where it awaits publication.
